d:
Welcome to Ghatshila! I found the most unbelievable, hidden paradise on my way to the Suvarnarekha River. This is the real-life Valley of Flowers (phulon ki ghati) that people travel to the Himalayas for!
But is this Heaven or is it Hell? This video explores the fascinating idea that Heaven (svarg) is any place where the presence of man is minimal. You will be mesmerized by the untouched natural beauty of the white, pink, and yellow wild flowers covering the hillsides of this Jharkhand hidden gem.
